semantics.arrival_model: each client starts its next transaction after the previous transaction completes
semantics.connection_lifetime: persistent for each client during one run
semantics.connection_path: pg-meta-1 pgbench client to pg-test-1 primary PostgreSQL port 5432

transaction_mix.business_meaning: read one product and its current inventory
read the five most recent historical orders for one customer

transaction_mix.key_distribution: uniform customer_id and Zipfian product_id, parameter 1.10
transaction_mix.business_meaning: lock and decrement inventory, then append one durable order

controls.cache_policy: warm naturally; never drop OS cache or restart PostgreSQL
controls.background_policy: observe and retain background activity; do not disable it
controls.statistics_policy: take before/after snapshots; never reset counters

interpretation.closed_loop_limit: The probe reveals maximum-throughput behavior for a fixed client population but does not reproduce an offered arrival rate or queue abandoned by an upstream caller.
interpretation.percentile_rule: Quantiles are computed from transaction samples; quantiles are never averaged.
interpretation.repetition_rule: Cell estimates report median runs and a deterministic bootstrap interval; five runs do not erase systematic bias.
interpretation.cold_cache_rule: No cold-cache claim is permitted because neither PostgreSQL nor operating-system caches are cleared.
interpretation.client_rule: A result is conditional when pg-meta-1 client CPU or scheduling can explain the measured ceiling.
interpretation.knee_rule: Two concurrency levels can only bracket a knee; a denser open-loop or concurrency sweep is required to locate it.
